main.description: A minimal public place or venue record. Independently authored; not copied from any Subcults source. Never a private address, door code, staffing or money field.

locality.description: Public city or town, standing in for a full street address.

region.description: Public administrative region, for example a state or province.

coordinates.description: Coarse public coordinates. Only present when the operator explicitly marked this place's coordinates public; a private-address grant never populates this field.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the place record was created.

geo.description: A WGS84 coordinate pair, bounded to prevent embedding excess precision or unrelated text.
